                 Product description                                 
                             The iO is Oral-B’s best technology: Clinically Proven 400% More Plaque Removal Along Gumline versus a regular manual toothbrush. A Round head and gentle micro-vibrations, the Magnetic interaction delivers smooth, harmonious motion through a Synchronized cleaning action (micro-vibrations synced with oscillations). A Built-in-2-Minute Timer ensures an even easier experience, helping you get an optimal clean on all your teeth. The Oral-B's quadrant timer breaks the two minutes up into four 30-second intervals to clean each quadrant of your mouth; we keep the time, so you don’t have to. Delivering the perfect pressure is done by having a Pressure Sensor. The Pressure Sensor Indicates optimal cleaning pressure and warns of over pressure. With an accompanying travel case, you’ll have a fresh clean everywhere you go. We’re with you on your next trip or even your mid-day on-the go brushing! Best of all, it is brought to you by Oral-B—the #1 brand used by dentists worldwide.* *Based on surveys of a representative worldwide sample of dentists carried out for P&G regularly. Do not use on children under age 3. Replace brush (head) every 3 months or sooner if brush head becomes worn.

        $('.main-header').removeClass("suggestion-layer");
        $('body').removeClass("main-cl");

        $("#" + searchelid).blur();

    function setSuggestionContent(res){
        data="<ul class='suggestion-item'>";
        total_suggestion=res.length;
        prefix=search_key
        for(i=0;i<total_suggestion;i++){
            if(res[i]['suggType']=="KeywordSuggestion"){
                item_value=res[i]['value'];
                item_str_parts=item_value.split(prefix);
                prefix_before="";
                if(item_str_parts[0].length>0){
                    prefix_before=item_str_parts[0];
                }
                if(typeof item_str_parts[1] !== 'undefined'){

                    data+="<li><span class='font-weight-bold'>"+prefix_before+"</span>"+prefix+"<span class='font-weight-bold'>"+item_str_parts[1]+"</span></li>";
                }
                else{
                    data+="<li><span class='font-weight-bold'>"+item_value+"</span></li>";

                }
            }
        }
        data+="</ul>";
        console.log("total_suggestion "+total_suggestion+" prefix.length"+prefix.length)
        if(jQuery('.'+suggestion_list).length==0){

            jQuery('#search-form-sm').append("<div class='suggestion-list'></div>");
        }
        if(total_suggestion>0 && prefix.length>0){

            jQuery('.'+suggestion_list).show();
            jQuery('.'+suggestion_list).html(data);
        }
        else{
            jQuery('.'+suggestion_list).html("");
            jQuery('.'+suggestion_list).hide();
        }
    }

    function suggestionKeyHandler(e) {
        el = $(e.target);
        str = el.val().trim();
        item_len = $('.' + suggestion_list_item).children().length;
        data = [];
        if (e.keyCode == 40) { /* down key */
            e.preventDefault();
            if (current_cursor < item_len) {
                current_cursor++;
            } else {
                current_cursor = 0;
            }
            jQuery(suggestion_item_id).removeClass("active");
            jQuery(suggestion_nth_item + "(" + current_cursor + ")").addClass("active");
            s_item_content = jQuery(suggestion_nth_item + "(" + current_cursor + ")").text();
            if (s_item_content.length > 0) {
                el.val(s_item_content);
            } else {
                el.val(search_key);
            }
        } else if (e.keyCode == 38) { /* up key */
            e.preventDefault();
            if (current_cursor > 0) {
                current_cursor--;
            } else {
                current_cursor = item_len;
            }
            jQuery(suggestion_item_id).removeClass("active");
            jQuery(suggestion_nth_item + "(" + current_cursor + ")").addClass("active");
            s_item_content = jQuery(suggestion_nth_item + "(" + current_cursor + ")").text();
            if (s_item_content.length > 0) {
                el.val(s_item_content);
            } else {
                el.val(search_key);
            }
        } else if (e.keyCode == 27) { /* esc key */
            hideSuggestionBox();
        } else {
            current_cursor = 0;
        }
    }
    function suggestionMouseHandler(e) {
        if (e.which == 3) {
            return false;
        }
        /* if the target of the click isn't the container nor a descendant of the container */
        if (!container.is(e.target) && !$("#" + searchelid).is(e.target))
        {
            hideSuggestionBox();
        }
        if ($(e.target).parents().hasClass(suggestion_list_item))
        {
            s_item_content = jQuery(e.target).text();
            if (e.target.tagName == "SPAN") {
                s_item_content = jQuery(e.target).parent("li").text();
            }
            if (s_item_content.length) {
                $("#" + searchelid).val(s_item_content);
                container.submit();
            }
        }
    }
    
    $(document).ready(function () {
        $(document).on('mouseup', function (e) {
            suggestionMouseHandler(e);
        });
        $("#" + searchelid).on('keydown', function (e) {
            suggestionKeyHandler(e);
        });
        $("#" + searchelid).on('input focus', function (e) {
            autocomplete(e);
        });
    });

    function FBViewContent(web_product_id, i) {
        //console.log('fbq',i);
        if (i > 5)
            return;
        try {
            var eventID = "event-" + Date.now() + "-" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000);
            sessionStorage.setItem("fb_event_id", eventID);
            fbq('track', 'ViewContent', {
                content_ids: [web_product_id],

                value: p_price,
                currency: p_currency_symbol,
            }, {eventID: eventID});
        } catch (error) {
            i++;
            setTimeout(function() {
                FBViewContent(web_product_id, i);
            }, 2000);
        }
    }

    function getOgMeta(og_meta_obj) {

 jQuery($ => {
  const LIMIT = 50;
  jQuery(".ub_review-text").each(function () {
    const $p = jQuery(this);
    const $btn = $p.find(".view-more-text");
    if (!$btn.length) return;

    const fullText = $p.clone().find(".view-more-text").remove().end().text().trim();
    const words = fullText.split(/\s+/);
   
    if (words.length <= LIMIT) return $btn.hide();
    const truncated = words.slice(0, LIMIT).join(" ");
    const remainder = words.slice(LIMIT).join(" ");
 
    $p.html(`
      ${truncated}<span class="ellipsis">... </span>
      <span class="more-text" style="display:none;"> ${remainder}</span>
    `).append($btn.text($btn.data("more-text") || "read more").show());
   
    $btn.on("click", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const isExpanded = $p.find(".more-text").is(":visible");
     
      jQuery(".ub_review-text").each(function () {
        const $review = jQuery(this);
        $review.find(".more-text").hide();
        $review.find(".ellipsis").show();
        $review.find(".view-more-text").text($review.find(".view-more-text").data("more-text") || "Read More");
      });
      
      if (!isExpanded) {
        $p.find(".more-text").show();
        $p.find(".ellipsis").hide();
        $btn.text($btn.data("less-text") || "Read Less");
      }
    });
  });
});

    function createChart(xValues, yValues, price_h_currencyCode) {

        var localMinimaPoints = [];
        for (let i = 1; i < yValues.length - 1; i++) {
            if (yValues[i] < yValues[i - 1] && yValues[i] < yValues[i + 1]) {
                localMinimaPoints.push(i);
            }
        }

        var pointBorderColor = yValues.map((value, index) => {
            return localMinimaPoints.includes(index) ? 'transparent' : '#FFB100';
        });

        myChart = new Chart("myChart", {
            type: "line",
            data: {
                labels: xValues,
                datasets: [{
                    fill: false,
                    lineTension: 0,
                    backgroundColor: "#FFB100",
                    borderColor: "#cccccc96",
                    data: yValues,
                    pointRadius: 5,
                    pointBorderColor: pointBorderColor,
                }]
            },
            options: {
                legend: {
                    display: false
                },
                layout: {
                    padding: {
                        left: 10,
                        right: 10,
                        top: 10,
                        bottom: 10
                    }
                },
                scales: {
                    xAxes: [{
                        display: true,
                        ticks: {
                            // Include a dollar sign in the ticks
                            callback: function(value, index, ticks) {
                                return value;
                            }
                        },
                    }],
                    yAxes: [{
                        display: true,
                        scaleLabel: {
                            display: true,
                            labelString: yAxes_label,
                            fontSize: 16 // Adjust font size of the label
                        }
                    }]
                },
                tooltips: {
                    callbacks: {
                        label: function(tooltipItem, data) {
                            const otherData = tooltipItem.yLabel;
                            return ` ${price_h_currencyCode} ${otherData}`;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        return myChart;
    }

                    history_query_params.currencyCode = 'AED';

        jQuery.ajax({
            type: "GET",
            url: history_url,
            dataType: "JSON",
            data: {
                p: history_query_params,
            },
            success: function(resp) {
                jQuery(".line-chart").find(".span_spinner").remove();
                jQuery(".line-chart").removeClass('loading');
                if (resp.status == true) {
                    jQuery('.priceHistorySection').removeClass('d-none');
                    jQuery(".line-chart .content").removeClass('d-none');
                    var xValues = resp.xValues;
                    var yValues = resp.yValues;
                    if (typeof curr_price != "undefined") {

                            var d = new Date();
                            var today = `${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getFullYear()).slice(-2)}`;
                            yValues.push(curr_price);
                            xValues.push(today);
                            if (yValues.length > 5) yValues = yValues.slice(-5);
                            if (xValues.length > 5) xValues = xValues.slice(-5);

                            // Replicated this logic from PHP Code where it is in reverse order.
                            resp.is_good_time_to_buy = false;
                            for (var i = yValues.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                                var single_price = yValues[i];
                                if (single_price !== curr_price) {
                                    if (single_price > curr_price) {
                                        resp.is_good_time_to_buy = true;
                                    }
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    price_h_currencyCode = resp.currencyCode;
                    myChart = createChart(xValues, yValues, price_h_currencyCode);

                    price_notes = price_notes.replace('%s', '<strong>' + price_h_currencyCode + '</strong>');
                    jQuery('.price_h_currency_note').html(`<p>${price_notes}</p>`);
                    if (resp.is_good_time_to_buy == true && is_pre_order != '1' && is_pre_order != 1) {
                        jQuery('#priceHistoryButton').removeClass('d-none');
                    }else{
                        jQuery('.priceHistorySection').addClass('d-none');
                    }
                } else {
                    jQuery('.priceHistorySection').addClass('d-none');
                }
            },
        });
    }

                    : thumbSlider.params.slidesPerView;

                const currentThumbIndex = thumbSlider.activeIndex;
                const endVisibleIndex = currentThumbIndex + slidesPerView;
                if (index < currentThumbIndex || index >= endVisibleIndex) {
                  thumbSlider.slideTo(index);
                }
                updateNavButtons(this);
              },
            },
          });
          navNext.addEventListener("click", () => {
            mainSlider.slideNext();
          });

          navPrev.addEventListener("click", () => {
            mainSlider.slidePrev();
          });

          thumbSlider.slides.forEach((slide, index) => {
            slide.addEventListener("click", () => {
              mainSlider.slideTo(index);
              updateThumbActive(index);
            });
          });
          function updateThumbActive(index) {
            thumbSlider.slides.forEach((slide) =>
              slide.classList.remove("swiper-slide-thumb-active")
            );
            if (thumbSlider.slides[index]) {
              thumbSlider.slides[index].classList.add("swiper-slide-thumb-active");
            }

            navPrev.style.display = "none";
            navNext.style.display = "none";

          const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
          const breakpoints = thumbSlider.params.breakpoints;
          let definedSlidesPerView = 3;
          for (const bp of Object.keys(breakpoints).map(Number).sort((a, b) => b - a)) {
            if (windowWidth >= bp) {
              definedSlidesPerView = breakpoints[bp].slidesPerView;
              break;
            }
          }
          const thumbSlideCount = thumbSlider.slides.length;
          if (thumbSlideCount < definedSlidesPerView) {

                    const $container = $image.closest(".main-product-slider .swiper-slide");
                    if ($container.find(".zoom-lens").length === 0) {
                        $container.append('<div class="zoom-lens"></div>');
                    }
                    const $lens = $container.find(".zoom-lens");
                    const lensWidth = 100;
                    const lensHeight = 100;
                    const zoomLevel = 2;
                    $lens.addClass("active").css({
                        width: lensWidth,
                        height: lensHeight,
                    });
                    let animationFrameId = null;
                    $container.on("mousemove", function(e) {
                        if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
                        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                            const containerOffset = $container.offset();
                            let x = e.pageX - containerOffset.left;
                            let y = e.pageY - containerOffset.top;
                            let lensX = x - lensWidth / 2;
                            let lensY = y - lensHeight / 2;
                            lensX = Math.max(0, Math.min(lensX, $container.width() - lensWidth));
                            lensY = Math.max(0, Math.min(lensY, $container.height() - lensHeight));
                            $lens.css({
                                left: lensX + "px",
                                top: lensY + "px",
                            });
                            const translateX = -(lensX * zoomLevel);
                            const translateY = -(lensY * zoomLevel);
                            $image.css({
                                transform: `scale(${zoomLevel}) translate(${translateX / zoomLevel}px, ${translateY / zoomLevel}px)`,
                            });
                        });
                    });
                    $container.on("mouseleave", function() {
                        $lens.removeClass("active").hide();
                        $image.css({
                            transform: "scale(1) translate(0, 0)",
                        });
                        if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
                    });
                });
            }

        if (element.attr("required") || element.hasClass("imageUpload")) {
            if (element.val() !== '') {
                var id_name = element.attr('id');
                var errorElement = jQuery('#' + id_name + '_error');
                if (errorElement.length) {
                    total_custom_price = 0;
                    errorElement.html('');
                    errorElement.removeClass('error_required');
                }
            }
        }
        if (element.attr('type') === 'file') {
            var file = element[0].files[0];
            var wrapper = jQuery(this).closest('.image-group');
            var preview_img = wrapper.find('.imgPreview');
            var preview_div = wrapper.find('.img_priview');
            var input_element = jQuery(this);
            var id_name = input_element.attr('id');
            if (file) {
                var file_type = file.type;
                var file_size = file.size / (1024 * 1024);
                if (file_size > 15) {
                    preview_img.attr('src', '');
                    preview_div.addClass('d-none');
                    errorElement.html('File size must not exceed 15 MB.').addClass('error_required');
                } else if (file_type === 'image/jpeg' || file_type === 'image/png' || file_type === 'image/jpg') {
                    preview_img.attr('src', URL.createObjectURL(file));
                    preview_div.removeClass('d-none');
                    errorElement.html('').removeClass('error_required');
                    jQuery('#submit_customData').prop('disabled', false);
                } else {
                    preview_img.attr('src', '');
                    preview_div.addClass('d-none');
                    errorElement.html(' File format must be JPEG, JPG or PNG.').addClass('error_required');
                }
            } else {
                preview_img.attr('src', '');
                preview_div.addClass('d-none');
                errorElement.html('').removeClass('error_required');
                jQuery('#submit_customData').prop('disabled', false);
            }
        }
        jQuery('.imageUpload').each(function () {
            var id = jQuery(this).attr('id');
            var err = jQuery('#' + id + '_error');
            if (err.length && err.hasClass('error_required') && err.html().trim() !== '') {
                jQuery('#submit_customData').prop('disabled', true);
            }
        });
    });

        jQuery(document).on('click', '#submit_customData', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled, .submit-disabled').removeClass('d-none');
            var isValid = true;
            var custom_arr = [];
            total_custom_price = 0;
            let usedHeadings = new Set(); 
            jQuery("input[type=radio][required]").each(function () {
                var name = jQuery(this).attr("name");
                var radioGroup = jQuery(`input[name="${name}"]`);               
                var selected = radioGroup.filter(":checked");
                var errorEl = jQuery(this).closest('.ub_form-row').find('.custom_error_box');
                if (!selected.length) {
                    if (errorEl.length > 0) {
                        errorEl.html("Provide missing information").addClass("error_required");
                    }
                    isValid = false;
                    jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                } else {
                    if (errorEl.length > 0) {
                        errorEl.html("").removeClass("error_required");
                    }
                }

            });

            jQuery("input[type='radio'].radio-custom:checked").each(function() {
                var radio = jQuery(this);                    
                var element_name = radio.attr('name');
                var element_value = radio.closest('label').find('.product-image-key').data('value') || radio.val();
                var imageUrl = radio.closest('label').find('img').attr('src');

            if (element_name && element_value && !usedHeadings.has(element_name)) {
                let obj = {
                    heading: element_name,
                    value: element_value
                };
                if (imageUrl) {
                    obj.image = imageUrl;
                }
                const price_match = element_value.match(/\+\s*\D{0,3}\s*(\d+)/);
                if (price_match) {
                    total_custom_price += parseInt(price_match[1]);
                }
                custom_arr.push(obj);
                usedHeadings.add(element_name);
               
            }
        });
        if (jQuery('.product-image-key').length > 0) {
            if (jQuery('.product-image-key.selected-image').length === 0) {
                var errorElement = jQuery('#select_heading_image_error');
                errorElement.html('Provide missing information');
                errorElement.addClass('error_required');
                jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                isValid = false;
            }
            jQuery(document).on('click', '.product-image-key', function () {
                if (jQuery(this).hasClass('selected-image')) {
                    jQuery('#select_heading_image_error').removeClass('error_required').html('');
                }
                    isValid = true;
            });
        }
        jQuery('.custom_heading').each(function(index, element) {
            var element = jQuery(element);
            if (element.attr("required") && element.val().trim() === '') {
                var id_name = element.attr('id');
                var errorElement = jQuery('#' + id_name + '_error');
                if (errorElement.length) {
                    total_custom_price = 0;
                    errorElement.html('Provide missing information');
                    errorElement.addClass('error_required');
                    jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                }
                isValid = false;
                return;
            }
            if (isValid) {
                var element_value = element.val();
                var element_name = element.attr('name');
                if (element_value !== '' && element_name !== '') {
                    if (element.attr('type') === 'file') {
                        var file = element[0].files[0];
                        if (file) {
                            custom_arr.push({
                                heading: element_name,
                                value: file.name
                            });
                        }
                    } else {
                        let clean_value = element_value
                            .replace(/\n/g, " ")
                            .replace(/'/g, "")
                            .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
                            .trim();
                        custom_arr.push({
                            heading: element_name,
                            value: clean_value
                        });
                        var match = element_value.match(/\b[A-Z]{3}\b(?=\s*\d+)/);
                        symbol = match ? match[0] : '';
                        if (element_value.includes(symbol)) {
                            const price_number = element_value.match(/\+\s*\D*(\d+)/)?.[1];
                            if (price_number) {
                                total_custom_price += parseInt(price_number);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        if (isValid){
            jQuery("#custom_form").val(JSON.stringify(custom_arr));
            var form = document.getElementById("custom_forms");
            var formData = new FormData(form);
            custom_arr.forEach((item) => {
                var heading = item.heading.trim();
                var value = item.value;
                var image = item.image;
                var existing = formData.get(heading);
                if (image && !(existing instanceof File && existing.name)) {
                    formData.set(heading, JSON.stringify({
                        value: value,
                        image: image
                    }));
                } else if (!formData.has(heading)) {
                    formData.set(heading, value);
                }
            });
            var base_image_url = 'https://en-ae.ubuy.com/ubcommon/common/generate_s3_image';
            for (var pair of formData.entries()) {
                if (pair[0] === "qty") {
                    jQuery("#custom_qty").val(pair[1]);
                }
            }
            jQuery.ajax({
                url: base_image_url,
                type: 'POST',
                data: formData,
                processData: false,
                contentType: false,
                dataType: 'json',
                success: function(response) {
                    if (response.status === true) {
                        custom_arr = custom_arr.map(function(item) {
                            var item_name = item.heading.replace(/\./g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '_');
                            Object.keys(response).forEach(function(key) {
                                var custom_cdn = key.replace(/\./g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '_');
                                if (custom_cdn === item_name && typeof response[key] === 'object') {
                                    if (response[key].value) {
                                        item.value = response[key].value;
                                    }
                                    if (response[key].image) {
                                        item.image = response[key].image;
                                        var input = jQuery('[name="' + item.heading + '"]');
                                        if (input.length && input.attr('type') === 'file') {
                                            item.value = '';
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }); 
                            return item;
                        });
                        jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                        jQuery("#custom_form").val(JSON.stringify(custom_arr));
                        var old_price = parseInt('0');
                        var final_product_price = old_price;
                        jQuery("#customization_price").val(symbol + "-" + total_custom_price);
                        jQuery('.product-price h2').html(symbol + " " + final_product_price + ' <span itemprop="price" content="' + final_product_price + '"></span>');
                        jQuery('.customize-disabled, .submit-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                        jQuery('#product_addtocart_form').submit();
                        jQuery('#customiseFormModal').modal('hide');
                    }
                },
                error: function(error) {
                    console.log(error);
                }
            });
        }
    });

    function previewImage(inputId) {
        var $input = jQuery('#' + inputId);
        var file = $input[0].files[0];
        var $previewContainer = jQuery('#image-preview-container-' + inputId);
        var $previewImage = jQuery('#image-preview-' + inputId);
        if (file && file.type.startsWith('image')) {
            var reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function (event) {
                $previewImage.attr('src', event.target.result);
                $previewContainer.show();
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        } else {
            $previewContainer.hide();
        }
    }

    function swapElements(el1, el2) {
        let prev1 = el1.prev();
        let prev2 = el2.prev();
        if (prev1.length != 0 && prev2.length != 0) {
            prev1.after(el2);
            prev2.after(el1);
        }
    }

            while (c.charAt(0) == ' ')

            if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) == 0)
                return c.substring(nameEQ.length, c.length);
        }
        return null;
    }

 jQuery($ => {
  const LIMIT = 50;
  jQuery(".ub_review-text").each(function () {
    const $p = jQuery(this);
    const $btn = $p.find(".view-more-text");
    if (!$btn.length) return;

    const fullText = $p.clone().find(".view-more-text").remove().end().text().trim();
    const words = fullText.split(/\s+/);
   
    if (words.length <= LIMIT) return $btn.hide();
    const truncated = words.slice(0, LIMIT).join(" ");
    const remainder = words.slice(LIMIT).join(" ");
 
    $p.html(`
      ${truncated}<span class="ellipsis">... </span>
      <span class="more-text" style="display:none;"> ${remainder}</span>
    `).append($btn.text($btn.data("more-text") || "read more").show());
   
    $btn.on("click", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const isExpanded = $p.find(".more-text").is(":visible");
     
      jQuery(".ub_review-text").each(function () {
        const $review = jQuery(this);
        $review.find(".more-text").hide();
        $review.find(".ellipsis").show();
        $review.find(".view-more-text").text($review.find(".view-more-text").data("more-text") || "Read More");
      });
      
      if (!isExpanded) {
        $p.find(".more-text").show();
        $p.find(".ellipsis").hide();
        $btn.text($btn.data("less-text") || "Read Less");
      }
    });
  });
});

                    : thumbSlider.params.slidesPerView;

                    const $image = jQuery(this);
                    const $container = $image.closest(".main-product-slider .swiper-slide");
                    if ($container.find(".zoom-lens").length === 0) {
                        $container.append('<div class="zoom-lens"></div>');
                    }
                    const $lens = $container.find(".zoom-lens");
                    const lensWidth = 100;
                    const lensHeight = 100;
                    const zoomLevel = 2;
                    $lens.addClass("active").css({
                        width: lensWidth,
                        height: lensHeight,
                    });
                    let animationFrameId = null;
                    $container.on("mousemove", function(e) {
                        if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
                        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                            const containerOffset = $container.offset();
                            let x = e.pageX - containerOffset.left;
                            let y = e.pageY - containerOffset.top;
                            let lensX = x - lensWidth / 2;
                            let lensY = y - lensHeight / 2;
                            lensX = Math.max(0, Math.min(lensX, $container.width() - lensWidth));
                            lensY = Math.max(0, Math.min(lensY, $container.height() - lensHeight));
                            $lens.css({
                                left: lensX + "px",
                                top: lensY + "px",
                            });
                            const translateX = -(lensX * zoomLevel);
                            const translateY = -(lensY * zoomLevel);
                            $image.css({
                                transform: `scale(${zoomLevel}) translate(${translateX / zoomLevel}px, ${translateY / zoomLevel}px)`,
                            });
                        });
                    });
                    $container.on("mouseleave", function() {
                        $lens.removeClass("active").hide();
                        $image.css({
                            transform: "scale(1) translate(0, 0)",
                        });
                        if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
                    });
                });
            }
        });

            if (element.val() !== '') {
                var id_name = element.attr('id');
                var errorElement = jQuery('#' + id_name + '_error');
                if (errorElement.length) {
                    total_custom_price = 0;
                    errorElement.html('');
                    errorElement.removeClass('error_required');
                }
            }
        }
        if (element.attr('type') === 'file') {
            var file = element[0].files[0];
            var wrapper = jQuery(this).closest('.image-group');
            var preview_img = wrapper.find('.imgPreview');
            var preview_div = wrapper.find('.img_priview');
            var input_element = jQuery(this);
            var id_name = input_element.attr('id');
            if (file) {
                var file_type = file.type;
                var file_size = file.size / (1024 * 1024);
                if (file_size > 15) {
                    preview_img.attr('src', '');
                    preview_div.addClass('d-none');
                    errorElement.html('File size must not exceed 15 MB.').addClass('error_required');
                } else if (file_type === 'image/jpeg' || file_type === 'image/png' || file_type === 'image/jpg') {
                    preview_img.attr('src', URL.createObjectURL(file));
                    preview_div.removeClass('d-none');
                    errorElement.html('').removeClass('error_required');
                    jQuery('#submit_customData').prop('disabled', false);
                } else {
                    preview_img.attr('src', '');
                    preview_div.addClass('d-none');
                    errorElement.html(' File format must be JPEG, JPG or PNG.').addClass('error_required');
                }
            } else {
                preview_img.attr('src', '');
                preview_div.addClass('d-none');
                errorElement.html('').removeClass('error_required');
                jQuery('#submit_customData').prop('disabled', false);
            }
        }
        jQuery('.imageUpload').each(function () {
            var id = jQuery(this).attr('id');
            var err = jQuery('#' + id + '_error');
            if (err.length && err.hasClass('error_required') && err.html().trim() !== '') {
                jQuery('#submit_customData').prop('disabled', true);
            }
        });

        jQuery(document).on('click', '#submit_customData', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled, .submit-disabled').removeClass('d-none');
            var isValid = true;
            var custom_arr = [];
            total_custom_price = 0;
            let usedHeadings = new Set(); 
            jQuery("input[type=radio][required]").each(function () {
                var name = jQuery(this).attr("name");
                var radioGroup = jQuery(`input[name="${name}"]`);               
                var selected = radioGroup.filter(":checked");
                var errorEl = jQuery(this).closest('.ub_form-row').find('.custom_error_box');
                if (!selected.length) {
                    if (errorEl.length > 0) {
                        errorEl.html("Provide missing information").addClass("error_required");
                    }
                    isValid = false;
                    jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                } else {
                    if (errorEl.length > 0) {
                        errorEl.html("").removeClass("error_required");
                    }
                }

            });

            jQuery("input[type='radio'].radio-custom:checked").each(function() {
                var radio = jQuery(this);                    
                var element_name = radio.attr('name');
                var element_value = radio.closest('label').find('.product-image-key').data('value') || radio.val();
                var imageUrl = radio.closest('label').find('img').attr('src');

            if (element_name && element_value && !usedHeadings.has(element_name)) {
                let obj = {
                    heading: element_name,
                    value: element_value
                };
                if (imageUrl) {
                    obj.image = imageUrl;
                }
                const price_match = element_value.match(/\+\s*\D{0,3}\s*(\d+)/);
                if (price_match) {
                    total_custom_price += parseInt(price_match[1]);
                }
                custom_arr.push(obj);
                usedHeadings.add(element_name);
               
            }
        });
        if (jQuery('.product-image-key').length > 0) {
            if (jQuery('.product-image-key.selected-image').length === 0) {
                var errorElement = jQuery('#select_heading_image_error');
                errorElement.html('Provide missing information');
                errorElement.addClass('error_required');
                jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                isValid = false;
            }
            jQuery(document).on('click', '.product-image-key', function () {
                if (jQuery(this).hasClass('selected-image')) {
                    jQuery('#select_heading_image_error').removeClass('error_required').html('');
                }
                    isValid = true;
            });
        }
        jQuery('.custom_heading').each(function(index, element) {
            var element = jQuery(element);
            if (element.attr("required") && element.val().trim() === '') {
                var id_name = element.attr('id');
                var errorElement = jQuery('#' + id_name + '_error');
                if (errorElement.length) {
                    total_custom_price = 0;
                    errorElement.html('Provide missing information');
                    errorElement.addClass('error_required');
                    jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                }
                isValid = false;
                return;
            }
            if (isValid) {
                var element_value = element.val();
                var element_name = element.attr('name');
                if (element_value !== '' && element_name !== '') {
                    if (element.attr('type') === 'file') {
                        var file = element[0].files[0];
                        if (file) {
                            custom_arr.push({
                                heading: element_name,
                                value: file.name
                            });
                        }
                    } else {
                        let clean_value = element_value
                            .replace(/\n/g, " ")
                            .replace(/'/g, "")
                            .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
                            .trim();
                        custom_arr.push({
                            heading: element_name,
                            value: clean_value
                        });
                        var match = element_value.match(/\b[A-Z]{3}\b(?=\s*\d+)/);
                        symbol = match ? match[0] : '';
                        if (element_value.includes(symbol)) {
                            const price_number = element_value.match(/\+\s*\D*(\d+)/)?.[1];
                            if (price_number) {
                                total_custom_price += parseInt(price_number);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        if (isValid){
            jQuery("#custom_form").val(JSON.stringify(custom_arr));
            var form = document.getElementById("custom_forms");
            var formData = new FormData(form);
            custom_arr.forEach((item) => {
                var heading = item.heading.trim();
                var value = item.value;
                var image = item.image;
                var existing = formData.get(heading);
                if (image && !(existing instanceof File && existing.name)) {
                    formData.set(heading, JSON.stringify({
                        value: value,
                        image: image
                    }));
                } else if (!formData.has(heading)) {
                    formData.set(heading, value);
                }
            });
            var base_image_url = 'https://bd-en.ubuy.com/ubcommon/common/generate_s3_image';
            for (var pair of formData.entries()) {
                if (pair[0] === "qty") {
                    jQuery("#custom_qty").val(pair[1]);
                }
            }
            jQuery.ajax({
                url: base_image_url,
                type: 'POST',
                data: formData,
                processData: false,
                contentType: false,
                dataType: 'json',
                success: function(response) {
                    if (response.status === true) {
                        custom_arr = custom_arr.map(function(item) {
                            var item_name = item.heading.replace(/\./g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '_');
                            Object.keys(response).forEach(function(key) {
                                var custom_cdn = key.replace(/\./g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '_');
                                if (custom_cdn === item_name && typeof response[key] === 'object') {
                                    if (response[key].value) {
                                        item.value = response[key].value;
                                    }
                                    if (response[key].image) {
                                        item.image = response[key].image;
                                        var input = jQuery('[name="' + item.heading + '"]');
                                        if (input.length && input.attr('type') === 'file') {
                                            item.value = '';
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }); 
                            return item;
                        });
                        jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                        jQuery("#custom_form").val(JSON.stringify(custom_arr));
                        var old_price = parseInt('0');
                        var final_product_price = old_price;
                        jQuery("#customization_price").val(symbol + "-" + total_custom_price);
                        jQuery('.product-price h2').html(symbol + " " + final_product_price + ' <span itemprop="price" content="' + final_product_price + '"></span>');
                        jQuery('.customize-disabled, .submit-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                        jQuery('#product_addtocart_form').submit();
                        jQuery('#customiseFormModal').modal('hide');
                    }
                },
                error: function(error) {
                    console.log(error);
                }
            });
        }
    });

    function previewImage(inputId) {
        var $input = jQuery('#' + inputId);
        var file = $input[0].files[0];
        var $previewContainer = jQuery('#image-preview-container-' + inputId);
        var $previewImage = jQuery('#image-preview-' + inputId);
        if (file && file.type.startsWith('image')) {
            var reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function (event) {
                $previewImage.attr('src', event.target.result);
                $previewContainer.show();
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        } else {
            $previewContainer.hide();
        }
    }

    function suggestionKeyHandler(e) {
        el = $(e.target);
        str = el.val().trim();
        item_len = $('.' + suggestion_list_item).children().length;
        data = [];
        if (e.keyCode == 40) { /* down key */
            e.preventDefault();
            if (current_cursor < item_len) {
                current_cursor++;
            } else {
                current_cursor = 0;
            }
            jQuery(suggestion_item_id).removeClass("active");
            jQuery(suggestion_nth_item + "(" + current_cursor + ")").addClass("active");
            s_item_content = jQuery(suggestion_nth_item + "(" + current_cursor + ")").text();
            if (s_item_content.length > 0) {
                el.val(s_item_content);
            } else {
                el.val(search_key);
            }
        } else if (e.keyCode == 38) { /* up key */
            e.preventDefault();
            if (current_cursor > 0) {
                current_cursor--;
            } else {
                current_cursor = item_len;
            }
            jQuery(suggestion_item_id).removeClass("active");
            jQuery(suggestion_nth_item + "(" + current_cursor + ")").addClass("active");
            s_item_content = jQuery(suggestion_nth_item + "(" + current_cursor + ")").text();
            if (s_item_content.length > 0) {
                el.val(s_item_content);
            } else {
                el.val(search_key);
            }
        } else if (e.keyCode == 27) { /* esc key */
            hideSuggestionBox();
        } else {
            current_cursor = 0;
        }
    }
    function suggestionMouseHandler(e) {
        if (e.which == 3) {
            return false;
        }
        /* if the target of the click isn't the container nor a descendant of the container */
        if (!container.is(e.target) && !$("#" + searchelid).is(e.target))
        {
            hideSuggestionBox();
        }
        if ($(e.target).parents().hasClass(suggestion_list_item))
        {
            s_item_content = jQuery(e.target).text();
            if (e.target.tagName == "SPAN") {
                s_item_content = jQuery(e.target).parent("li").text();
            }
            if (s_item_content.length) {
                $("#" + searchelid).val(s_item_content);
                container.submit();
            }
        }
    }

    function FBViewContent(web_product_id, i) {
        //console.log('fbq',i);
        if (i > 5)
            return;
        try {
            var eventID = "event-" + Date.now() + "-" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000);
            sessionStorage.setItem("fb_event_id", eventID);
            fbq('track', 'ViewContent', {
                content_ids: [web_product_id],
                content_type: 'product',
                value: p_price,
                currency: p_currency_symbol,
            }, {eventID: eventID});
        } catch (error) {
            i++;
            setTimeout(function() {
                FBViewContent(web_product_id, i);
            }, 2000);
        }
    }

    function getOgMeta(og_meta_obj) {
        var meta_html = '';
        jQuery.each(og_meta_obj, function(key, val) {
            meta_html += '<meta property="' + key + '" content="' + val + '">';
        });
        return meta_html;
    }

    function createChart(xValues, yValues, price_h_currencyCode) {

        var localMinimaPoints = [];
        for (let i = 1; i < yValues.length - 1; i++) {
            if (yValues[i] < yValues[i - 1] && yValues[i] < yValues[i + 1]) {
                localMinimaPoints.push(i);
            }
        }

        var pointBorderColor = yValues.map((value, index) => {
            return localMinimaPoints.includes(index) ? 'transparent' : '#FFB100';
        });

        myChart = new Chart("myChart", {
            type: "line",
            data: {
                labels: xValues,
                datasets: [{
                    fill: false,
                    lineTension: 0,
                    backgroundColor: "#FFB100",
                    borderColor: "#cccccc96",
                    data: yValues,
                    pointRadius: 5,
                    pointBorderColor: pointBorderColor,
                }]
            },
            options: {
                legend: {
                    display: false
                },
                layout: {
                    padding: {
                        left: 10,
                        right: 10,
                        top: 10,
                        bottom: 10
                    }
                },
                scales: {
                    xAxes: [{
                        display: true,
                        ticks: {
                            // Include a dollar sign in the ticks
                            callback: function(value, index, ticks) {
                                return value;
                            }
                        },
                    }],
                    yAxes: [{
                        display: true,
                        scaleLabel: {
                            display: true,
                            labelString: yAxes_label,
                            fontSize: 16 // Adjust font size of the label
                        }
                    }]
                },
                tooltips: {
                    callbacks: {
                        label: function(tooltipItem, data) {
                            const otherData = tooltipItem.yLabel;
                            return ` ${price_h_currencyCode} ${otherData}`;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        return myChart;
    }

        jQuery(document).ready(function () {
          const thumbSlider = new Swiper(".product-thumbnail-slider", {
            slidesPerView: "auto",
            slidesPerGroup: 1,
            spaceBetween: 15,
            loop: false,
            centeredSlides: false,
            breakpoints: {
              1600: { slidesPerView: 5 },
              1200: { slidesPerView: 4 },
              992: { slidesPerView: 3 },
              0: { slidesPerView: 3 },
            },
          });
          const navPrev = document.querySelector(".main-prev1");
          const navNext = document.querySelector(".main-next1");
          function updateNavButtons(slider) {
            if (slider.isBeginning) {
              navPrev.classList.add("swiper-button-disabled");
            } else {
              navPrev.classList.remove("swiper-button-disabled");
            }

            if (slider.isEnd) {
              navNext.classList.add("swiper-button-disabled");
            } else {
              navNext.classList.remove("swiper-button-disabled");
            }
          }
          mainSlider = new Swiper(".main-product-slider", {
            loop: false,
            on: {
              slideChange: function () {
                const index = this.activeIndex;
                updateThumbActive(index);

                const slidesPerView =
                  thumbSlider.params.slidesPerView === "auto"
                    ? Math.floor(thumbSlider.slidesPerViewDynamic() || 1)
                    : thumbSlider.params.slidesPerView;

                const currentThumbIndex = thumbSlider.activeIndex;
                const endVisibleIndex = currentThumbIndex + slidesPerView;
                if (index < currentThumbIndex || index >= endVisibleIndex) {
                  thumbSlider.slideTo(index);
                }
                updateNavButtons(this);
              },
            },
          });
          navNext.addEventListener("click", () => {
            mainSlider.slideNext();
          });

          navPrev.addEventListener("click", () => {
            mainSlider.slidePrev();
          });

          thumbSlider.slides.forEach((slide, index) => {
            slide.addEventListener("click", () => {
              mainSlider.slideTo(index);
              updateThumbActive(index);
            });
          });
          function updateThumbActive(index) {
            thumbSlider.slides.forEach((slide) =>
              slide.classList.remove("swiper-slide-thumb-active")
            );
            if (thumbSlider.slides[index]) {
              thumbSlider.slides[index].classList.add("swiper-slide-thumb-active");
            }
          }
          updateThumbActive(0);
          updateNavButtons(mainSlider);

          const hideNav = () => {
            navPrev.style.display = "none";
            navNext.style.display = "none";
          };
          const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
          const breakpoints = thumbSlider.params.breakpoints;
          let definedSlidesPerView = 3;
          for (const bp of Object.keys(breakpoints).map(Number).sort((a, b) => b - a)) {
            if (windowWidth >= bp) {
              definedSlidesPerView = breakpoints[bp].slidesPerView;
              break;
            }
          }
          const thumbSlideCount = thumbSlider.slides.length;
          if (thumbSlideCount < definedSlidesPerView) {
            hideNav();
            return;
          }
        });

    
        jQuery(document).ready(function() {
            if (jQuery(window).width() > 768) {
                jQuery(".main-product-slider .swiper-slide").on("mouseenter", ".zoom-image", function() {
                    const $image = jQuery(this);
                    const $container = $image.closest(".main-product-slider .swiper-slide");
                    if ($container.find(".zoom-lens").length === 0) {
                        $container.append('<div class="zoom-lens"></div>');
                    }
                    const $lens = $container.find(".zoom-lens");
                    const lensWidth = 100;
                    const lensHeight = 100;
                    const zoomLevel = 2;
                    $lens.addClass("active").css({
                        width: lensWidth,
                        height: lensHeight,
                    });
                    let animationFrameId = null;
                    $container.on("mousemove", function(e) {
                        if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
                        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                            const containerOffset = $container.offset();
                            let x = e.pageX - containerOffset.left;
                            let y = e.pageY - containerOffset.top;
                            let lensX = x - lensWidth / 2;
                            let lensY = y - lensHeight / 2;
                            lensX = Math.max(0, Math.min(lensX, $container.width() - lensWidth));
                            lensY = Math.max(0, Math.min(lensY, $container.height() - lensHeight));
                            $lens.css({
                                left: lensX + "px",
                                top: lensY + "px",
                            });
                            const translateX = -(lensX * zoomLevel);
                            const translateY = -(lensY * zoomLevel);
                            $image.css({
                                transform: `scale(${zoomLevel}) translate(${translateX / zoomLevel}px, ${translateY / zoomLevel}px)`,
                            });
                        });
                    });
                    $container.on("mouseleave", function() {
                        $lens.removeClass("active").hide();
                        $image.css({
                            transform: "scale(1) translate(0, 0)",
                        });
                        if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
                    });
                });
            }
        });

        jQuery(document).on('click', '#submit_customData', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled, .submit-disabled').removeClass('d-none');
            var isValid = true;
            var custom_arr = [];
            total_custom_price = 0;
            let usedHeadings = new Set(); 
            jQuery("input[type=radio][required]").each(function () {
                var name = jQuery(this).attr("name");
                var radioGroup = jQuery(`input[name="${name}"]`);               
                var selected = radioGroup.filter(":checked");
                var errorEl = jQuery(this).closest('.ub_form-row').find('.custom_error_box');
                if (!selected.length) {
                    if (errorEl.length > 0) {
                        errorEl.html("Provide missing information").addClass("error_required");
                    }
                    isValid = false;
                    jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                } else {
                    if (errorEl.length > 0) {
                        errorEl.html("").removeClass("error_required");
                    }
                }

            });

            jQuery("input[type='radio'].radio-custom:checked").each(function() {
                var radio = jQuery(this);                    
                var element_name = radio.attr('name');
                var element_value = radio.closest('label').find('.product-image-key').data('value') || radio.val();
                var imageUrl = radio.closest('label').find('img').attr('src');

            if (element_name && element_value && !usedHeadings.has(element_name)) {
                let obj = {
                    heading: element_name,
                    value: element_value
                };
                if (imageUrl) {
                    obj.image = imageUrl;
                }
                const price_match = element_value.match(/\+\s*\D{0,3}\s*(\d+)/);
                if (price_match) {
                    total_custom_price += parseInt(price_match[1]);
                }
                custom_arr.push(obj);
                usedHeadings.add(element_name);
               
            }
        });
        if (jQuery('.product-image-key').length > 0) {
            if (jQuery('.product-image-key.selected-image').length === 0) {
                var errorElement = jQuery('#select_heading_image_error');
                errorElement.html('Provide missing information');
                errorElement.addClass('error_required');
                jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                isValid = false;
            }
            jQuery(document).on('click', '.product-image-key', function () {
                if (jQuery(this).hasClass('selected-image')) {
                    jQuery('#select_heading_image_error').removeClass('error_required').html('');
                }
                    isValid = true;
            });
        }
        jQuery('.custom_heading').each(function(index, element) {
            var element = jQuery(element);
            if (element.attr("required") && element.val().trim() === '') {
                var id_name = element.attr('id');
                var errorElement = jQuery('#' + id_name + '_error');
                if (errorElement.length) {
                    total_custom_price = 0;
                    errorElement.html('Provide missing information');
                    errorElement.addClass('error_required');
                    jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                }
                isValid = false;
                return;
            }
            if (isValid) {
                var element_value = element.val();
                var element_name = element.attr('name');
                if (element_value !== '' && element_name !== '') {
                    if (element.attr('type') === 'file') {
                        var file = element[0].files[0];
                        if (file) {
                            custom_arr.push({
                                heading: element_name,
                                value: file.name
                            });
                        }
                    } else {
                        let clean_value = element_value
                            .replace(/\n/g, " ")
                            .replace(/'/g, "")
                            .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
                            .trim();
                        custom_arr.push({
                            heading: element_name,
                            value: clean_value
                        });
                        var match = element_value.match(/\b[A-Z]{3}\b(?=\s*\d+)/);
                        symbol = match ? match[0] : '';
                        if (element_value.includes(symbol)) {
                            const price_number = element_value.match(/\+\s*\D*(\d+)/)?.[1];
                            if (price_number) {
                                total_custom_price += parseInt(price_number);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        if (isValid){
            jQuery("#custom_form").val(JSON.stringify(custom_arr));
            var form = document.getElementById("custom_forms");
            var formData = new FormData(form);
            custom_arr.forEach((item) => {
                var heading = item.heading.trim();
                var value = item.value;
                var image = item.image;
                var existing = formData.get(heading);
                if (image && !(existing instanceof File && existing.name)) {
                    formData.set(heading, JSON.stringify({
                        value: value,
                        image: image
                    }));
                } else if (!formData.has(heading)) {
                    formData.set(heading, value);
                }
            });
            var base_image_url = 'https://en-ae.ubuy.com/ubcommon/common/generate_s3_image';
            for (var pair of formData.entries()) {
                if (pair[0] === "qty") {
                    jQuery("#custom_qty").val(pair[1]);
                }
            }
            jQuery.ajax({
                url: base_image_url,
                type: 'POST',
                data: formData,
                processData: false,
                contentType: false,
                dataType: 'json',
                success: function(response) {
                    if (response.status === true) {
                        custom_arr = custom_arr.map(function(item) {
                            var item_name = item.heading.replace(/\./g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '_');
                            Object.keys(response).forEach(function(key) {
                                var custom_cdn = key.replace(/\./g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '_');
                                if (custom_cdn === item_name && typeof response[key] === 'object') {
                                    if (response[key].value) {
                                        item.value = response[key].value;
                                    }
                                    if (response[key].image) {
                                        item.image = response[key].image;
                                        var input = jQuery('[name="' + item.heading + '"]');
                                        if (input.length && input.attr('type') === 'file') {
                                            item.value = '';
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }); 
                            return item;
                        });
                        jQuery('.customize-atc-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                        jQuery("#custom_form").val(JSON.stringify(custom_arr));
                        var old_price = parseInt('0');
                        var final_product_price = old_price;
                        jQuery("#customization_price").val(symbol + "-" + total_custom_price);
                        jQuery('.product-price h2').html(symbol + " " + final_product_price + ' <span itemprop="price" content="' + final_product_price + '"></span>');
                        jQuery('.customize-disabled, .submit-disabled').addClass('d-none');
                        jQuery('#product_addtocart_form').submit();
                        jQuery('#customiseFormModal').modal('hide');
                    }
                },
                error: function(error) {
                    console.log(error);
                }
            });
        }
    });

                var asin = jQuery("#asin").val();
                var parent_sku = jQuery("#parent_sku").val();
                var brand_name = jQuery("#brand_name_en").val();
                var price = jQuery('.price-box').find('span[itemprop="price"]').attr('content');
                var list_price = jQuery(".price-box").find(".product-old-price").first().text().trim();
                var list_price = list_price.match(/\d+/g)?.[0] || "";
                var flag_store = 'us';
                var symbol = 'QUVE';
                var stockText = jQuery("#availability-status").text().trim().toLowerCase();
                var stock = (stockText.includes("in stock")) ? 1 : 0;
                var seller_data = {
                    seller_info_url: seller_info_url,
                    asin: asin,
                    brand_name: brand_name,
                    price: price,
                    list_price: list_price,
                    seller_name: seller_name,
                    symbol: symbol,
                    flag_store: flag_store,
                    parent_sku: parent_sku,
                    stock:stock,
                }
                seller_data = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(seller_data))));
                jQuery.ajax({
                    type: "GET",
                    data: {
                        seller_data : seller_data
                    },
                    url: seller_full_info,
                    dataType: "html",
                    success: function (response) {
                        jQuery("#seller-info-btn").removeClass("loading");
                        jQuery("#seller-info-btn .span_spinner").remove();
                        jQuery(".seller-info-popup").removeClass("d-none");
                        jQuery(".seller-info-popup").attr("id", "seller-info");
                        jQuery(".seller-info-popup").html(response);
                        jQuery(".seller-info-popup").modal('show');
                        jQuery(".seller-name").find(".span_spinner").remove(); 
                    }
                }); 
            }
        });
    });

  setTimeout(function() {
    if (timing !== 0) {
